Foreign investors pull over Rs 44,000 crore from Indian equities

Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have withdrawn Rs 44,166 crore from Indian equities in October so far. This brings total FPI outflows in 2026 to over Rs 3 lakh crore. Elevated crude oil prices, a stronger US dollar, and high US bond yields are cited as factors weighing on investor sentiment.
